description: This file defines a custom exception class 'UnknownCommandException' used within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter to indicate that a command is not supported. It includes builder methods, static factory methods for creating instances from messages or JSON, and references several Ditto framework classes.

classes.name: UnknownCommandException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating an unsupported command, extending DittoRuntimeException with static factory methods for construction and a builder class.

classes.name: UnknownCommandException.Builder
classes.description: A fluent builder class for constructing instances of UnknownCommandException, supporting customization of message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for UnknownCommandException, initialized with the unsupported command name.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an UnknownCommandException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an UnknownCommandException by parsing a JSON object and associating it with headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the exception with a new set of DittoHeaders.
